title: Python Curriculum
description: A complete Python learning path from syntax foundations to advanced patterns and standard library mastery.
longDescription:
## Python Curriculum

This track walks you through Python from the ground up. Start with core syntax and data types, then move into object-oriented programming, CPython internals, idiomatic patterns, and finally the standard library.

### What you will learn

- Variables, control flow, functions, and data structures
- Classes, inheritance, dunder methods, and descriptors
- How CPython works under the hood: bytecode, memory, GIL
- Pythonic idioms: comprehensions, generators, decorators, context managers
- itertools, collections, functools, and other stdlib essentials
